basic_details.job_title: Cuddalore District Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Support Person, Translator and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Cuddalore District has announced vacancies for 3 posts including Support Person, Translator, and Interpreter on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can apply offline by submitting their application by hand or post to The District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, No. 312, Second Floor on or before 6 November 2026, starting from 13 October 2026. Applicants must possess a Postgraduate degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development, Child Welfare, Health or a related field, or a degree in a child welfare related field with 3 years of experience. content_sections.heading: Cuddalore District Support Person at a Glance
Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their applications along with copies of their educational certificates and relevant supporting documents to the official postal address given below. The District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, No. 312, Second Floor, District Collectorate Office, Cuddalore – 607 001.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development, Child Welfare, Health or any other related field OR candidates must possess a degree in a field related to child welfare and have a minimum of three years of experience in the relevant field. faq.question: Q1. What positions are available in Cuddalore District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment notification invites applications for the positions of Support Person, Translator, and Interpreter.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are to be filled for the positions under the POCSO Act, 2012.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of applications is 06.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development, Child Welfare, Health or a related field, or a degree in a child welfare related field with 3 years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by post or by hand to the designated office address.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to The District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, No. 312, Second Floor, District Collectorate Office, Cuddalore – 607 001.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or pay scale for these positions?
faq.answer: The official notification does not state the salary details.
